items.title: Bennie Turner Interview, 1972-02-09
items.q: You see, Louis Kiffin was playing with Handy at the time.

ctx.x: You came in with a new band. I came in with Handy.
You see, Louis Kiffin was playing with Handy at the time. He had some kind of falling out in the audience.
And you mentioned the Budweiser too.
